# S-DELI

> S-DELI documents and preserves endangered African sign languages while advocating for deaf community rights and linguistic preservation across Nigeria.

S-DELI (Sociolinguistics and Deaf Education and Linguistics Initiative) is a Nigerian organization focused on linguistic fieldwork, sign language documentation, and community advocacy. The organization combines academic research on Indigenous Nigerian Sign Language and Magajingari Sign Language with practical outreach programs serving deaf communities across Nigeria and Africa.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous Nigerian Sign Language (INSL)
- Sign Language Documentation
- Magajingari Sign Language (MgSL)
- Deaf Communities
- Linguistic Preservation
- Nigeria
- Kaduna State
- African Sign Linguistics
- Endangered Languages
- Deaf Education
- Language Fieldwork
- Nigerian National Association of the Deaf (NNAD)
- Lexical Documentation
- Community Outreach
- Interpreter Training

## Sign Language Documentation Projects

- [Indigenous Nigerian Sign Language Documentation Project (INSLDP)](https://www.s-deli.org/portfolio/project-the-documentation-of-nigerian-sign-language): INSLDP: Documenting Indigenous Nigerian Sign Language and Magajingari Sign Language
- [General Report on the Indigenous Nigerian Sign Language Documentation Project](https://www.s-deli.org/portfolio/general-report-indigenous-nigerian-sign-language-documentation-project): Comprehensive report on INSL documentation fieldwork in Kaduna State and Magajingari

## Education and Training Programs

- [Online Certificate Course on African Sign Linguistics and Interpreting](https://www.s-deli.org/portfolio/online-certificate-course-on-african-sign-linguistics-and-interpreting): Online certificate course on African Sign Linguistics and interpreter training

## Community Advocacy and Outreach

- [Beauty Beyond Speech Campaign](https://www.s-deli.org/portfolio/beauty-beyond-speech-campaign): Campaign against sexual abuse and violence targeting deaf girls across Africa
- [Community Service Outreach in 5 Deaf Schools/Units in Lagos State](https://s-deli.org/portfolio/community-service-outreach-5-deaf-schools-units-lagos-state): S-DELI community outreach program in Lagos State deaf schools with peer mentoring
